name: Kbd
label: Kbd
description: A keyboard key rendered as a keycap, for shortcut hints in menus and prose.

props.name: children
props.description: The key legend — e.g. ⌘, K, Esc, Shift. Ignored when `keys` is set.

props.name: keys
props.description:
A whole shortcut in the shortcut grammar (`mod+k`, `shift+?`, `g i`),
drawn as one keycap per key in the platform's legends: ⌘ K on a Mac,
Ctrl K elsewhere. The server draws the non-Apple legends and the browser
settles on its own after hydration.

props.name: keyLabels
props.description: Replaces any legend `keys` is drawn with, such as `{ ctrl: 'Strg' }` for a German keyboard. Merged over the platform's defaults.
